comment.text: Button label in a migration dialog used to confirm a payment, where {{amount}} represents the formatted currency value.

usage.context:
<div className={styles.footerButtons}>
 <Button
 key="confirm"
 label={
 cardCharge > 0
 ? t("MigratePay", {
 amount: subscriptionDetails
 ? formatPaymentCurrency(cardCharge, 2)
 : "",
 })
 : t("UpgradeNow")
